CORRECTION_2026_11_22.what_was_wrong: my bucket (a), 'submitted late AND overlapping a robot prefill', was read as ENGINE blocking and used to conclude that at rung 2 the engine flag (layer 1) addressed the dominant loss. That reading is WRONG. Overlap is not causation: the user measured release delay (t_submit minus t_opportunity) at rung 2 p50 0.74 s and p90 0.97 s of a 1.0 s deadline, against the base's 0.30 and 0.89, with 72 percent over 0.5 s against 37. With a 0.74 s median hold a monitor overlaps whatever happens to be running, so the overlap test cannot distinguish 'the prefill delayed it' from 'it was held and the prefill was there'. This is a proxy-validity failure (CLAUDE.md check 6) in my own artefact
